封装、转换 MP4 和 Matroska 文件并编辑其标签

description.p: Media Muxing Wizard muxes and remuxes tracks from many containers and raw streams into MP4 (M4V, M4A, M4B, MOV) and Matroska (MKV, MKA, WebM) files, converting audio and subtitles where the target needs it, and edits their metadata without re-encoding: iTunes-style tags, cover art, chapters, track names, languages, alternate groups, fallbacks and accessibility characteristics. A batch queue applies the same changes to many files.
